# Vendor Contracts & Procurement

Controls selection, onboarding, contracting, ordering, invoicing, renewal, and termination of suppliers that FLOW depends on.

## Pre-commitment checks
Legal vendor identity, quotation/pricing, business need/budget, service scope, auto-renewal/cancellation terms, data/security access, privacy/subprocessor impact, payment/bank details, tax treatment, service continuity, and internal owner.

## End-to-end chain
```text
Need → vendor evaluation → legal/security/privacy/finance checks → contract/PO → delivery/acceptance → invoice → tax/WHT → approval/payment → accounting/reconciliation → renewal monitoring → termination/export/deletion when retired
```

## Register rule
Every material recurring vendor should have owner, contract/terms reference, renewal/cancellation deadline, fee basis, security/data classification, and secure evidence link.
